recalibratedAtMerge: onto main with B-00 (shipped-notes score, composer split), B-01 (ArrangementArc: drums enter at the chorus, bass thinned in quiet sections, chorus 2 developed, keys in every section, ensemble/mix not a family) and B-03 (instrument profiles); see the PR-B05a tracker entry
method: every critic dimension over every anchor x control; detected = score drop >= 1 and a located non-info observation new or upgraded on the damaged tracks; rate with exact Clopper-Pearson 95 % interval; a control whose damage leaves an anchor unchanged skips that anchor
ledgerRule: gated: strongest claimed control >= 0.90 with CI lower >= 0.60 and no blocking observation on a clean anchor; informing: >= 0.50; demoted: measured (n >= 5) and < 0.50; uncalibrated: no claimed control measurable

controls.description: A share of notes moved to another scale degree within the context's key: the line stays diatonic but its contour and its chord relationship are no longer the composer's. (share of notes moved: 15 % / 35 % / 60 %)
A share of notes moved a semitone to a pitch outside the context's key: wrong notes against the tonality. (share of notes moved: 10 % / 25 % / 50 %)
Notes sitting on tones of the sounding estimated chord are moved to the nearest diatonic non-chord tone: the part stops supporting the harmony. (share of chord-tone notes moved: 20 % / 40 % / 70 %)

A contiguous run of bars is displaced by an octave (two at severity 3): the phrase leaves the instrument's register and the line breaks at both ends. (share of the window displaced: 25 % / 50 % / 75 % of bars; one octave, one octave, two octaves)
Stepwise motions are replaced by leaps of a sixth to a seventh onto a scale tone: the line loses its smoothness while staying in key. (share of stepwise motions turned into leaps: 20 % / 40 % / 70 %)

A run of bars is replaced by another context part's line doubled at the unison or octave: the part loses its independence and moves in parallel perfect intervals with the ensemble. (share of the window doubled: 35 % / 60 % / 100 % of bars)
A share of onsets is pushed off the metric grid by a random fraction of a beat: the part no longer locks to the ensemble's pulse. (30 % / 50 % / 70 % of onsets, by up to ⅛ / ¼ / ½ beat)
Every onset is snapped to a coarser grid — the beat, the half-bar, the bar — so subdivisions and syncopations collapse onto strong positions. (grid: one beat / two beats / one bar)
Off-beat onsets are moved onto the nearest beat: the groove is straightened out. (share of off-beat onsets moved: 40 % / 70 % / 100 %)
A share of notes is removed at random: the part is thinner than the ensemble expects, with holes where the composer wrote motion. (share of notes removed: 30 % / 50 % / 70 %)
Notes are subdivided into repeated halves: the part becomes busier and more mechanical than the composer's. (share of notes subdivided: 30 % / 60 % / 100 %)
Bars are overwritten with a copy of the bar before them (severity 3: every bar is bar one): the part stops developing. (share of bars overwritten: ⅓ / ⅔ / all bars copy bar one)
The whole part is shifted late by whole beats against the unchanged ensemble: phrase starts and cadences no longer land where the harmony moves. (shift: one / two / three beats)

Recurrences of the part's own four-note cells are rewritten as an in-key random walk with the same rhythm: the motif is stated once and never returns. (share of recurrences rewritten: 50 % / 75 % / 100 %)
A share of notes is moved to a pitch a semitone from a context note sounding at that moment: sustained clashes against the ensemble. (share of notes moved into a clash: 15 % / 30 % / 50 %)

The part is transposed by octaves to the other side of the ensemble — a bass line above the melody, a top line under the bass — so the instrument no longer plays its role. (past the ensemble's upper/lower quartile / clear of the whole ensemble / a further octave beyond)

Blocks of bars are exchanged while the ensemble stays in order: the part's music is real but arrives at the wrong point in the passage. (two adjacent two-bar blocks swapped / the halves swapped / the bar order reversed)
The part's velocities are compressed, flattened, or inverted about their mean: shaping and accents are lost or contradicted. (compressed by half / flat / accents inverted)
Notes that end before a chord change are held across it: the part hangs over into the next harmony without resolving. (30 % / 50 % / 80 % of such notes held ½ / 1 / 2 beats past the change)
the bass replaced by one root per chord alternating octaves: every move a leap of a seventh or more
the brass (or winds) part sustained without a breath: each note held to the next onset, the last to the end of the song
chorus 1 pasted over chorus 2 in every part (velocities included): identity kept, development removed
two of every three onset clusters deleted from every part in every chorus: the loud section is the thin one
every pitched track removed (the audit's Probe 5 outcome)
at every section boundary the drums' last bar becomes a copy of the bar before it and the pitched pickups in the last beat are deleted

at every boundary where the plan asks for a drum_fill the drums' last bar becomes a copy of the bar before it (skipped when no drum bar changes: a drummer who is silent before every planned fill has no fill to erase)
the pitched pickups in the last beat before every section boundary are deleted (skipped when there is none)
every velocity set to the song mean and every part that does not play in the quietest section deleted from the climax
every pitched part re-timed to strike its current voicing on every eighth: one rhythm for the whole ensemble, no air
a chordal part thinned to a single note per bar: a bed that is no longer a chord, comping with no rhythm
a chordal part's voicings spread by an octave per voice: no hand reaches them
the audit's Probe 1 composer: the reference rhythm with random pitches (steps ≤ 7) in every pitched part
a planned harmonic part (keys / guitar / synth / strings) removed entirely
the sustained bed (strings, else pad, else keys) transposed up two octaves: out of its band, above the vocal, out of its comfortable range
all controllers removed and every onset snapped to the exact sixteenth grid: a sequencer, not a player
the planned climax section's notes exchanged with the quietest section's in every part

every other onset of each harmonic part displaced an octave up: the audible top line leaps an octave at every move (parts whose top voice never reaches seven notes in a section carry no line to make erratic and are skipped)
while the vocal sings, every harmonic part's voicing is transposed so its top voice sits on the sung pitch
every part plays in every section: its busiest section's bars are looped into the bars of the sections where it did not play (sounded in fewer than a quarter of the bars)
every velocity set to 80 in every part

chorus 1 pasted over chorus 2 in every part (velocities included): identity kept, development removed — applied to an anchor prepared by develop_chorus_2: chorus 2 developed against chorus 1: the sustained bed lifted an octave and every part +10 velocity in chorus 2

at every section boundary the drums' last bar becomes a copy of the bar before it and the pitched pickups in the last beat are deleted — applied to an anchor prepared by realise_boundaries: the planned boundary devices realised: a two-beat snare/tom fill in the bar before every planned drum_fill (the drummer's entry fill when the drums were silent), and two eighth-note pickups in the last beat before every planned bass/keys/guitar pickup
